title: Domain Tecnaria connector catalog

supportingSourceFiles.coverage: Root public exports for the Tecnaria connector catalog constants and lookup

sourceOracles.coverage: Tecnaria connector catalog types and values are consumed through the source factory; direct catalog lookup, serialization, unsupported and error parity are covered by the independent live test

independentValidation.method: Strict declaration consumer coverage and independently executed pinned JavaScript versus built TypeScript catalog modules, including exact catalog JSON, numeric values, Unicode code-point comparisons, frozen type-list behavior, direct-reference behavior, unsupported/null results and inherited-property errors.

tolerances.serializedParity: exact JSON serialization for catalog families, board-thickness entries and type lists
tolerances.numericParity: exact equality for every fvrk, kser and ku value and lookup result
tolerances.publicStrings: exact equality plus Unicode code-point equality

parityDifferences: The slice preserves the source catalog object shape, insertion order, numeric values, shallow-frozen connector type list, lookup coercion, direct returned references, null behavior and inherited-property errors.
TecnariaConnector, createTecnariaConnector, and additional connector, material and application functionality remain outside this bounded slice.
engineeringFunctionality: Generic Tecnaria connector catalog data and lookup only; no connector construction or verification is introduced.
